sloka: कथं नु खलु वाक्यं मे श्रुणुयान्नोद्विजेत वा ।इति संचिन्त्य हनुमांश्चकार मतिमान् मतिम् ।। ५.३०.४०।।।।
transliteration: kathaṁ nu khalu vākyaṁ me śruṇuyānnodvijeta vā ।iti saṁcintya hanumāṁścakāra matimān matim ।। 5.30.40।।।।

translations.english: Wise Hanuman came to a decision after reflecting in his mind about how not to create fear in Sita (while communicating with her.)
